name: ConvertForce Popup Builder
author: Imtiaz Rayhan

sections.description:
ConvertForce Popup Builder helps you convert more visitors into subscribers and customers with beautiful, lightweight popups, top bars, bottom bars, and floating notification banners built right inside the WordPress Block Editor.

Whether you want to promote an offer, show announcements, or grab attention with sticky bars and alert messages, ConvertForce makes it easy.

Key Features

  • 🔥 Create Popups & Bars Using WordPress Block Editor – Use native blocks to design popups, banners, and bars just like any other block-based content.
  • 📢 3 Display Types Out of the Box – Notification Bar (top/bottom), Lightbox, and Slide-in.
  • 🎯 Conversion-Focused Templates (Coming Soon) – Pre-built designs for announcement bars, alert banners, promotion bars, and more.
  • 🎨 Customizable Appearance – Set width, background, animation, sticky behavior, and positioning (top or bottom).
  • 🧩 Works With All Themes & Plugins – Fully compatible with all WordPress themes and block plugins.
  • ⚡ Blazing Fast and Lightweight – Loads only what’s needed. No bloat, no performance drag.

Great for

  • Creating announcement or alert bars
  • Promoting limited-time offers or discounts
  • Displaying sticky notices or banners
  • Boosting visibility of CTAs and updates

No coding needed. Just install, design, and convert.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/convertforce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ConvertForce > Add New Popup to create your first popup or notification bar.
  4. Customize the content using the block editor and configure display settings.
  5. Publish it and watch your conversions grow!
sections.faq:
Does it work with block themes?

Yes! ConvertForce is fully block-based and works seamlessly with all block themes.

Can I use other blocks inside the popup or bar?

Absolutely. You can use any core block.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes. The plugin is built to work with most caching and performance plugins out of the box.

Will it slow down my site?

Not at all. ConvertForce is performance-optimized and only loads minimal assets.

Can I create exit-intent popups?

Exit intent triggers will be available in future updates.
